reviews.text:
I cannot thank them enough for the incredible care they gave my Frenchie during his IVDD journey. From the very beginning, the doctors were compassionate, thorough, kind, and always available whenever I had questions or concerns. Every vet, nurse, and staff member treated my baby with so much love and attention, and they were just as supportive and caring toward me during such a stressful time.
This is by far the best place for my dog, and I truly felt like he was in the best hands possible. Thank you all so, so, so much for everything you did for us. I will forever be grateful for the amazing care, dedication, and compassion you showed my baby and our family. - Love, Mars :)

5 months post-op update, Mars is starting to take a couple of steps on his own now, we’ve been taking him to therapy (also with sevn— boyton location) weekly. We see improvement every single day. Words cannot express how grateful we are.

We were promised by the doctor that surgery would give a 90-95% chance for our 8 year old Dobie to significantly improve from her sudden and severe IVDD injury.  How could we not hand them all our money with those chances (even though it did seem a bit high)? We were told later by another doctor that 90-95% chance with her type of injury did not exist - it was more like 30-50%.  If only the SVN doctors would have told us the truth, I would have said this clinic is great.  But they were dishonest and had no problem taking tens of thousands of dollars from us.  It was such an emotional and rushed decision, and we fell for it......If there was an option for -5 stars, I would have chosen that one.

I'm not one to write reviews.  I felt the need to do so to give comfort and reassurance in the event someone is going through the same things as I have.  My dog started having seizures.   After doing my research, I contacted Southeast Veterinary Neurology.  They were able to schedule a consultation for the next morning.   Their diagnostic approach was thorough and complete.   Each member of their staff that I met was compassionate and knowledgeable.  I could not be more pleased with the level of service I received.  I truly felt that they put the welfare of my pet as a top priority.  Thank you
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.
dr. wong and the entire staff took exceptional care of my cat after she had a spinal cord injury. they’re extremely knowledgeable and attentive, and the front desk staff is so kind. highly recommend!

This establishment has done nothing but overcharge and dismiss my concerns . It’s horrible when you’re in the position to need these specialised places of treatment  and that they take advantage of our vulnerability is deplorable.

I took my dog Dobby here during Covid after he lost the use of his back legs. I was told he would never walk again, to crate him and manage his pain with pills. He was around 3-4 years old at that time. He was level 2 IVDD and I searched on YouTube finding their videos about helping another Frenchie that was stage 5. I know all cases are different but something in my gut told me to take him there. He’s about to hit his 10th Birthday and has never had any issues again. They gave him his quality of life back. He runs around like the happy little boy he is. I’m just realizing I never made a review about the amazing care he received here. I drove him all the way from Chicago just to get his surgery. It was the best decision I ever made and just have to give thanks. It was the scariest thing I’ve ever gone through, and since it was during Covid I couldn’t see him for a week. They would take pictures and send them to me so I knew he was okay. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I cannot express enough gratitude to the entire Neurology team for everything they have done for our Bentley. What has been one of the most frightening and emotional experiences for our family was made so much easier because we knew Bentley was surrounded by people who truly cared about him.

From the neurologists and surgeons to the nurses, technicians, and everyone involved in his care, we felt that Bentley was treated with compassion, patience, and dedication every step of the way.

His case became complicated and required two spinal surgeries within a very short period of time. The team acted quickly when his neurological condition changed, performed another MRI, identified the problem, and did everything possible to relieve the pressure on his spinal cord and give him the best chance at recovery. We are incredibly grateful for their persistence and commitment to him.

Throughout this difficult process, they kept us informed, answered our questions, explained what was happening, and cared for Bentley during the moments when we could not be there with him. Knowing that he was being closely monitored and cared for meant more to us than I can put into words.

Today, seeing Bentley regain deep pain sensation, voluntary movement in his back legs, eating, drinking, and urinating on his own gives us so much hope. We know his recovery is still a journey, but we are incredibly thankful that he has been given this opportunity.

To every doctor, neurologist, surgeon, nurse, technician, and staff member who participated in Bentley’s care and recovery: thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you for your knowledge, your dedication, your compassion, and for taking care of our Bentley as if he were one of your own.

Our family will never forget what you have done for him. ❤️🐾

With all our gratitude, Bentley’s family.
Great service, thank you ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to the entire team at South East Veterinary Neurology for the exceptional care, compassion, and dedication you showed our dog, Gordo, throughout his IVDD recovery. Thanks to your expertise and guidance, he is doing so much better and is walking more every day, which means the world to our family. A very special thank you to Heather and Abigail for your kindness, patience, and encouragement during every visit. Your genuine care and commitment made such a positive difference in Gordo's journey. We are incredibly grateful for everything you have done and will always appreciate the outstanding service and support your office provided. Thank you for helping Gordo regain his strength and giving us hope throughout his recovery.I highly recommend South East Veterinary Neurology to anyone whose pet needs neurological care. If you're looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and dedicated team that truly cares about your pet's well-being, this is the place to go.
Thanks to my dog’s neurologist and his staff we feel our pup Maxie is always in great hands.

I have had several surgeries at this facility on my Dachshunds, Frenchies and Bulldogs. I am happy to say I have had success with almost all of them. The staff is great and spends time with my dogs and most of all I love that they call often to check and see how they are doing with home after care. I cant say enough about this place.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.
The doctor and all the front desk staff were very kind, and the doctor's assistant is a sweetheart and super professional.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! It means the world to us to know we made a positive impact. We’re here for you and your pet anytime you need us!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.

We recently took our four-year-old Havanese, River, to a Southeast Veterinary Neurology after he began having seizure-like episodes, and we could not have been more impressed with the care we received.

From the very first phone call, scheduling was easy, and the staff was incredibly kind, compassionate, and empathetic during such a stressful time for our family. Everyone we encountered made us feel supported and cared for.

Dr. Westervelt, the neurologist, was outstanding. Though young, having graduated from Tufts University in 2024, she was exceptionally bright, professional, knowledgeable, and confident. She explained everything clearly and concisely, took time to answer our questions, and showed genuine care for River throughout the entire process.

River spent nearly five hours there undergoing extensive testing, and the entire staff treated him so gently and attentively. He did extremely well, and we left feeling informed, encouraged, and thankful for the excellent care he received.

We are incredibly grateful and would highly recommend this neurology center to anyone needing specialized veterinary care for their pet.

Thanks to this place I lost my beautiful angel best friend my husband and I payed 12,000 and he passed away March 11, 2023 . We did the impossible. Is been 3 years and I never got a letter to my address saying sorry for your loss just a simple well written letter . But then when chewy the big corporation found out about Thor my beagles sent me not only a letter but a painting 🖼️. Thank you chewy for your compassion and empathy that's why chewy who owns petsmart is one of the best animal company out there

October 2024 our Nairobi had seizures and we were referred to SEVN by Blue Pearl. Main vet Kornberg never came to see us personally, gave pills, took a quick $7k for MRI/spinal tap and overall did not feel the compassion of a vet towards a, now known, dying 4 year old cat. She puked out tons of pills that were not being digested by her body and just an overall bad experience at a dire time of need especially due to requesting to see the vet prescribing her medications and him not taking the time, and now our young cat is gone due to negligence.

I can't begin to express my gratitude for the staff and doctors. They took the time to answer all of my questions and made me feel supported throughout the entire process. I highly recommend this neurology veterinary team to anyone needing specialized care for their animal. Thank you :)

I recently brought my 8 y/o special needs Frenchie to SEVN after being referred by his primary for a neurology consultation. The team from the first phone call was extremely professional and thorough. I have unfortunately a lot of experience with different specialists for my dog and being new to South Florida was weary to enter another new specialist office. I was impressed with the entire team. After booking the initial appointment over the phone, I immediately felt comfortable bringing my dog in. The team was beyond kind, explained everything to me in a clear way and took as much time as we needed at the consult. I'm grateful to have established a relationship at SEVN.
Great staff and vets, professional and compassionate. Thanks!
Im very happy with my dog care! Everyone that took care of my pet. They are professional, caring staff and doctors.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! It means the world to us to know we made a positive impact. We’re here for you and your pet anytime you need us!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.

I truly don’t have enough words to thank the entire team at Southeast Veterinary Neurology for everything they did for my dog, Leo. From the very first moment, they treated us with professionalism, compassion, patience, and genuine care during one of the hardest moments of my life.
Leo arrived in severe pain with cervical neurological problems, and thanks to their team he received a complete evaluation, MRI, surgery, and specialized care. Communication throughout the entire process was excellent. They always kept me informed about his progress and answered all my questions with honesty and kindness.
The surgery went very well, and seeing Leo walk again and slowly recover has been an incredible relief for our family. You can truly tell that everyone there loves animals and is deeply dedicated to what they do.
I also want to mention how clean and organized the clinic is, and how supportive and caring the staff were with me the entire time. Even though it was an emotionally difficult experience, they made me feel that Leo was in the best hands possible.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for helping my baby Leo 🐶❤️
Amazing staff, clean, beautiful rooms and lobby, would definitely recommend to anyone I knew! Everyone we interacted with was so kind and helpful

I was really impressed by the welcome sign with my bulldog's name. Also, the time they take to attend to and explain what's happening with the pet. They are very professional. They've kept me updated remotely at all times; I never felt alone. Overall, I loved the service. The quality of the care was outstanding.
Excellent team. Great service. Everyone cared my enzo very good No a specific name. Everyone Personalization

While on a camping trip down in The Keys we found our 4yo Colliedoodle needing emergency care and were encouraged to travel from Sugarloaf Key to Miami to see the docs here at Southeast Vet.  We arrived at 9:30 pm where our boy was admitted for further testing.  Testing showed he had Megaesophagus and MyastheniaGravis.  Both diseases were new to us and difficult to manage.  While were weren't overall impressed with our assigned doctor (resident), we were impressed with the front desk staff.  They were friendly, compassionate, and helpful.  However, our 5-star rating actually is a reflection of Jen, our case manager.  Jen called us almost daily to check on Milo and us.  She knew we were on the road and recognized the difficult diagnosis.  She was kind, caring, thoughtful, and very thorough.  JEN helped up through some of our toughest days!!  We truly can't thank you enough.
ME and MG are tough diseases.  While we were from out of town, we felt like more details and information could have been shared by the doctors.  Milo had a tough 2.5 weeks before passing.  During that time we spoke with the doc/resident 2x and never were able to speak with the lead doc.  While we realized we were not their only patient, Milo was very sick.  If it hadn't been for Jen and the front desk, our rating would look very different.  Thanks Jen, you are truly a life saver!

The entire experience was seamless. From the intake call, to the appointment , explaining everything , surgery, keeping us informed, post care and follow up, everything was amazing. The doctors, nurses, front desk were so kind and helpful with everything. The nurse who took care of cookie was awesome !!!!! Loved the amount of time nurses spent on calls keeping us informed of every little thing

The experience has been excellent!
From the first time I called to make an appointment, the coordinator treated me so kindly that I could already imagine the rest. The clinic was spotless, they were already expecting me, and I went straight to a private room. After the exam, a whole team came to explain every detail of the diagnosis to me. And when I was leaving, another doctor explained everything they had done again. In short, I give them a 10!

Sent over by the ER. Girl on phone scheduling me is giving me all kinds of care and quotes for the care and I'm not even scheduled. Should have known right then. Then to take the appt they need my credit card and a 3% surcharge. And if I'm late, yes that's more $$$. They quoted an MRI at 5k!!! Insane. Im a Nurse for humans and we can do an MRI cash pay for 700$.  Insane. But, your pet is in trouble and you go, I went beyond my better knowing intuition.
They take my dog, examine her and I don't see a thing of it, it's in another room. So maybe no exam was done??  The doc comes in and has no good guess, recommendation or care that would start conservatively.  She has a list of things it could be. I could have given that list to myself. I stopped her in her attempt to upcharge the visit to rule out her list that would probably give us no answers and finally listened to my gut and left. These people don't care about your dog. They speak to you like you are a child. $285 down the drain without one intervention.
Went today, Sunday and got a good doctor, which I thought I would never find in Miami and got the info I needed and the recommended meds and care.
I don't want to hear from the receptionist on the care that might be needed and the cost before I even schedule. I want an appt and that's it. When you have a doctorate behind your name then I'll talk to you about care that MIGHT be needed and cost.and stop talking to people like they are children. Your pretty white board in the room and the free water don't make up for the fact that your pricing is ridiculous and the care sub par.

Negresco got the necessary attention and support from the moment we arrived until we left the clinic. Really good service. Everyone was super nice. Immediately serviced upon arrival and quickly started seeing Negresco.

Very friendly staff, engaging and accommodating. Very clean facilities. Loved the little touches of the writing on the board, that you could call at any time to check on your pet. I have no negative comments. To all the staff that helped Luna through this surgery, I thank you from the bottom of my heart. Traveling from the Bahamas was difficult enough, but the whole team at SEVN was very calming and reassuring. They took such good care of my baby Luna. The constant updates and photos

Very good customer service Dr.Jaquay, Barbara, Michelle, Stephanie, Bella, Kristobel are all excellent workers and have done an amazing job keeping me updated and posted for my baby. They an excellent team and will reccomend to everyone! My dog got diagnosed with autoimmune disease and they have kept it all realistic and answered all my questions and concerns immedietadly and even kept their word of reaching back to me. Amazing cannot describe how good this clinic is!

The staff was very kind and considerate. It was a sad situation but a nice environment. The clear and honest explanation from the vet along with the kind atmosphere of the staff and how well they took care of our Cotton made this sad situation feel a little better.

I cannot thank this team enough for the incredible care they gave my dog, Ruby. We came in as a complete crying mess after finding out she had IVDD, and from the very first phone call, Stephanie, the patient care coordinator, was kind, patient, and so reassuring during one of the hardest moments for us.

When we arrived, Brittany, Hilary, and Meg made the registration process smooth and helped calm us down right away. Gen, the room nurse, was so gentle and compassionate when taking Ruby to be examined. Meli, who cared for Ruby during her hospitalization, treated her with so much love and attention. It truly meant everything to us knowing she was being cared for like that.

Dr. Jaramillo, the resident doctor, was thorough and took the time to explain everything so we felt informed and supported. Dr. De Pompa, the neurologist who performed Ruby’s surgery, is absolutely amazing. His expertise gave us so much confidence during such a scary time.

And I cannot forget Barbie, the anesthesiologist, who kept Ruby safe and breathing throughout the surgery. That alone is something I will always be grateful for.

Every single person we encountered treated Ruby like their own. You can feel how much they truly care. Because of this team, Ruby is on her road to recovery and we have so much hope again.

Thank you for taking care of our girl when we needed it most. ❤️
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! It means the world to us to know we made a positive impact. We’re here for you and your pet anytime you need us!
We truly appreciate your 5-star review! Our team works hard to provide compassionate, high-quality care, and your feedback reassures us that we’re on the right track. Thank you!

Had an incredible experience at SEVN, Dr. Michelle was incredible from start to finish with our dog Kylo! After falling paralyzed in the back end everything went so smooth from surgery to recovery. I am so so happy I could trust them with such a scary situation and they did so amazing with making my partner and I feel supported and taken care of. I am so grateful!
Been here plenty of times with my frenchie. Don't have a bad thing to say about this place other than prices. Staff, cleanliness, communication, knowledge… they have it all :) Time
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.

We had an excellent experience with Brody appt . From the moment we arrived, the entire team was compassionate, patient, and incredibly thorough. They took the time to carefully evaluate Brody, explain everything in a way that was easy to understand, and answer every question we had without making us feel rushed.

Every single person that works there was so helpful and kind. From the first call with customer service to book appointment and get information they were so nice.

I totally recommend coming to visit them

We had an incredible experience with this team. Our four year old French bulldog, Opal, went from happy and playful to suddenly not being able to walk. In about 48 hours she went from seeming a little sore and lethargic, to losing use of one back leg, to being completely paralyzed in both. We were terrified.

Our local vet in the Florida Keys suspected IVDD and connected us with SEVN. From the very first phone call, they were amazing. Even though they probably hear the same fears and questions every day, they spoke to me with so much patience and empathy while I was literally in tears. They took the time to explain what might be happening, what the possible outcomes were, and did it honestly without giving false hope.  Also, everyone I spoke to, from the receptionist to the actual surgeon herself, Never made us feel rushed or hurried to get off the phone.

They were also the only office willing to discuss rough cost ranges over the phone. Living in the Keys means any specialist is a 4 to 8 hour drive, so having at least some idea of the financial expectations before making that trip meant a lot. They were also incredibly understanding about how overwhelming the numbers can feel and shared financing resources without any pressure.

After talking with others who had experience with IVDD and hearing positive things about SEVN, we scheduled Opal’s appointment the next day and my husband drove her up to Miami.

When he arrived, they already knew who Opal was and why she was there, which meant he didn’t have to repeat everything all over again. She even had a little welcome sign waiting for her. Since I couldn’t be there, they let my husband FaceTime me with her before taking her back, and the nurse holding Opal even jumped into a quick FaceTime selfie with us. It was a small thing, but it meant a lot in a really scary moment.

Thankfully, the MRI showed that she WAS a candidate for surgery, and the prognosis for a positive outcome was very likely. The rest of the intake process was seamless, and their new estimate, based on her scans, was happily on the lower end of what they had quoted us originally (still a lot of but they tried to minimize where they could).  The surgery went very smoothly, and My husband stayed in the area for a few days while she recovered, being able to bring her home a few days later.

I won’t lie, those first few days after the surgery were intense. It of course takes a while for everything to get back to normal, so we were still dealing with her going to the bathroom with our help, not being able to use her legs yet, and needing constant care and supervision. This is not for the faint of heart, I will say right now!  But, the team remained diligent and proactive to check in on us, ask how things were, and they were available at a moment’s notice by phone or text if we weren’t sure about something.

It was a few weeks before Opal was able to somewhat walk again, but we kept up with her exercises as advised, and she made great progress very quickly.  Her follow up appointment a few weeks later went well, we were told she was showing every sign of being on the right track, and again, even after that visit, they still checked in regularly.

I am happy to report that now, approximately 4 1/2 months later, she is very much back to her old self. While we obviously are much more careful about monitoring her activities, we do not allow her to go up and down the stairs of our stilt home, try to minimize her jumping/impact activities, and things like that, she otherwise is now living a normal, happy life. When we go out in the yard, she can run and play, chase lizards, and roll around in the grass.

This would not have been possible without the care, expertise, professionalism, compassion, and communication by Southeast Veterinary Neurology, who made an incredibly stressful situation so much easier to navigate. We are so grateful for the care they showed to our baby girl and could not recommend them enough to anyone who finds themselves in this scary and uncharted territory.  With love from the Bond Family.

I was referred here by VEG (vet ER) due to a tremor my dog has had in her legs, primarily one back leg, for over a year. When I called to schedule the appointment, I was told the consultation and physical exam would cost $220. Then I was asked to pay a deposit over the phone, which was the full $220 plus a convenience fee. I don’t see how that’s a deposit and not just up-front payment, but sure.

Then, the woman on the phone said that the doctor may recommend an MRI for further testing, and asked if I wanted an estimate for that. I said yes, and the estimate was “between $5,800 and $6,800.” This is in line with the other reviews that say this facility really pushes for MRIs and they’re always very expensive, considering they mentioned it to me on the phone during scheduling before even seeing my dog.

According to the PDF with the results that I received after the appointment, a Dr. Nick L. De Pompa performed the physical exam on my dog when they took her to the back, but this person never spoke to us or was mentioned during the appointment. Dr. Karlye Becker was the one to come speak to us after the exam.

She was very thorough in explaining that the tremors don’t appear to be a result of a spinal injury or to be affecting her negatively in any way, making this not an emergency. She said that the other medical issue my dog had at the time (two tumors in her abdomen) was more pressing to take care of and, although it would be generally helpful for getting more answers, she would understand the decision to forgo an MRI now in favor of treating the tumors. Which was my plan already; I just took her to this appointment because the vet ER who found the tumors also referred us here for the tremors, so I was seeking answers for both during the same time.

Now that we’ve treated the tumors through surgery, after my dog’s recovery, I may return here for further testing if the tremors get worse. But, for now, I think we’re okay. I’m on the fence about my experience here (hence the 3 stars). I think they would’ve pushed for the MRI if we didn’t have the more-pressing issue of the tumors at the time, even though Dr. Becker admitted that it may result in zero additional answers. And I probably would’ve felt pressured and helpless enough to pay those several thousand dollars to do it and ended up in the same position as we are now anyway. I’m glad Dr. Becker gave us an analysis that said that this doesn’t currently need treatment, but I’m not sure that would’ve happened if we weren’t in our very specific situation with the tumors.

Extremely competent , professional and attentive folks. All the way from check in to check out. We felt very comfortable with whatever would come about in the appointment; I knew they would provide us clarity and comfort. Dr. Elise was also extremely patient with all of our questions. She did not seem bothered or in a rush to help us. Dr. Elise helped turned the temperature of this scary situation all the way down. Answered all of our questions. We did not feel rushed. SO VALUABLE TO US. She even drew/explained the surgical procedure to us. She even walked through the post surgical timeline with us and how it would be possible to shorten it (if he was recovering well) since he is on so many anxiety medications. That was special. Charles name on the board, staff members friendly, phenomenal bedside manner by Dr Elise. Felt very safe leaving the facility.
Great work. Caring, thorough and took the time to explain all of our worries and concerns. Dr. Westervelt's knowledge and caring were superior.
Fantastic care provided by Dr. Kornberg. Thank you! The honesty, great communication and careful explanation was very much appreciated.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We are always striving to provide compassionate, high-quality care and would love the opportunity to learn more about your experience. If you’re open to sharing additional feedback, please contact our Practice Manager at your convenience. We truly value your input.

SEVN is a literal life saver. You guys saved my doxie when he suddenly got IVDD in July of 2025. He is 12 years old and is still doing great! You always answer the phone and allow me to talk about my concerns without making me feel like its a burden like some clinics do (unfortunately). A special thanks to Dr. Morocco for always being patient and kind. Thank you all for being amazing! Dr. Morocco is kind and patient! She understands that as a first time IVDD parent its so scary and she made the process smooth and effortless. Your kindness!

Dr Becker as wonderful. Explained her opinion of diagnosis and reasons why; presented options for further testing without pushing or trying to “oversell” the need for expensive tests. Made recommendations for care; total description of diagnosis (botulism). On the pricey side for exam and labs, but that’s the nature of veterinary medicine these days. Highly recommend this office

It was my first time visiting SEVN and I was nervous about my senior dog undergoing anesthesia. I also was scared and anxious about the possible outcomes. Everyone on staff, and especially Dr. Marocco, was wonderful. It is a difficult time for me and for my dog, but I was treated with care and compassion. I am grateful for the empathy and the expertise - and I'm grateful to the team for being so responsive to emails and phone calls - having those answered quickly makes me feel like I have a team supporting me through this on all the levels. Thank you for helping us.
friendly, patient and highly knowledgeable team.  highly recommend.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating! We are always here for you and your pet when you need us.

I had such a great experience. The staff is so friendly and attentive and really put me at ease during what was such an emotional time for me. Thank you to everyone The girls at the front desk , the nurses, Arielle, and Dr. Becker were all amazing Welcoming and informative

Everyone was super nice and cordial Everyone was great, sorry with everything going on about my dog I forgot the nurses names, but they were great The knowledge and the way me and my dog were treated. Overall they are Great!

They took great care of my kitty who almost passed away from a bladder almost rupture due to spinal cord compression. They performed emergency surgery and contacted me several times daily amd including pictures. Thank you so much for taking care of Neo. The whole staff is A+++. They clearly loved on my boyfriend Neo which is essential in healing. Your care touched my heart Their love
